mvp_description: Transportation/ride scheduling platform for seniors and disabled individuals

top_buyers.name: Ashtabula County Transportation System (ACTS)
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Provides door-to-door bus service with wheelchair accessibility and reduced fares for elderly/disabled. Ride scheduling platform would improve booking and tracking. County-operated transit system.

top_buyers.name: ReliaRide
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Leading NEMT provider in Northeast Ohio since 2007, specializing in elderly and disabled transport. Digital ride management would optimize their operations. Originated after seeing need for safe, professional nursing home transportation.

additional_contacts.name: Country Neighbor Senior Services
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Operates fleet of 10 vehicles including handicap-accessible vans for seniors. Ride scheduling platform would improve service coordination.

additional_contacts.name: Kings Transportation Services
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Provides ambulatory and wheelchair transportation in Cuyahoga, Lorain, and Ashtabula counties.

additional_contacts.name: Senior Transportation Connection
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Coordinates transportation for seniors and differently abled adults throughout Northeast Ohio.

research_notes: ACTS email inferred from county domain pattern. ReliaRide contact primarily by phone. Strong senior transportation infrastructure in Ashtabula County. Multiple NEMT providers present.
